description: Sends a message from a user to the VertoDigital team and returns a reference ID. It reaches the team's CRM and inbox, and the team replies to fromEmail, normally within one business day. Use it for service questions, partnerships, press, careers, or the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment (topic "assessment", with the company and main challenge in message). organization is saved as the company on the CRM record. Call it only with the user's consent and their real name and email. Each call creates a new enquiry, so do not retry one that succeeded. Rate-limited: over the limit it returns isError with a retry delay.
name: vertodigital_send_enquiry
